decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Before the relevant part of the works are commenced, full details of the construction of the reconstructed dormer shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and the work shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 5 - The works to the kitchen shown on drawings KS 21B and KS22B are excluded.
description: Erection of side bicycle shed, installation of new front dormer window and replacement balustrade to front elevation at second floor level , incorporating general refurbishments and external/internal alterations to house.
